description:
THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT ANNOUNCEMENT ONLY

The 436th Contracting Squadron is seeking information concerning the availability of small business concern contractors capable of providing the following services.

Description of Services - The contractor shall provide all necessary labor, materials, and equipment to perform specialty cleaning services at Dover AFB, DE, as detailed in this Performance Work Statement (PWS). These services include, but are not limited to, mold abatement, HVAC duct cleaning, and pressure washing.

Please see the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Bid Schedule for a more in depth overview and breakdown of the required services. Please provide current business size standard (e.g. Large or Small Business),  Small business socioeconomic status (if applicable), and applicable NAICS codes.

Submit your responses to:

Contracting Specialist - Bryce M. Ganske, bryce.ganske@us.af.mil

Contracting Officer - Dimas Bernacchia, dimas.bernacchia.2@us.af.mil

USE PDF VERSION OF PWS TITLED "Specialty Cleaning BPA PWS.pdf" TO ACCESS FILE.
